system.description:
You loose a howl, cry or other animal call, and the wild answers — creatures hastening to your side, ready to aid you or simply to offer up their blood.

Expend one Social Trait for each animal you summon. Only beasts that can actually hear the call respond, so you cannot summon a bird from across a city or call a creature beyond earshot; within a chosen type you may be as broad or as specific as you like (all the rats in an area, only the white ones, or one rat you know of). Summoned animals do not fall under your control but are at least favorably disposed, and they may take some time to arrive. They remain until they are attacked or threatened or until the scene ends, and other Animalism powers may be used to command them. Retest with Animal Ken.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
